title: ジャパンカップの後に・外柔内剛

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following a strong showing in the Japan Cup, Symboli Rudolf intends to ride her momentum to the Arima Kinen, where Maruzensky will also be competing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The news sees Rudolf, who has always been curious about Maruzensky, set alight with a quiet determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the next generation well on their way to following in her footsteps, Symboli Rudolf seems to have less weighing her down than before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And following Air Groove and her other friends' requests to race as her true self, she resolves to run the Arima Kinen not as the Emperor, but simply as Symboli Rudolf.
